cards.imageAlt: Figure 33，用于本话题的看图描述和问答

cards.audioText: Give a brief description about these pictures please.
cards.audioTextZh: 请对这些图片做简要描述。
cards.referenceText: The first picture is about the engine failure of a climbing aircraft. In the second picture, there are flames coming from the left engine during the aircraft rolling on the runway. As for the third picture, it shows the situation that the nose gear is still down during flying. And there is thick smoke in the cockpit which is shown in the last picture.
cards.referenceTextZh: 第一张图中，一架飞机在爬升中出现机械故障。第二张图中，飞机左发动机起火。第三张图中，飞机在飞行中前起落架仍然是放下的。最后一张图展示的是机舱内有浓烟。

cards.audioText: What would you do in the situation shown in the second picture?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果遭遇第二张图的情况你会怎样做？
cards.referenceText: The aircraft flames are out of its left engine during rotation. In this situation, I will continue to take off. After I reach 400 feet, I will declare an emergency and carry out the engine fire checklist. After that, I will make a short circuit and return for emergency landing. If I can not extinguish the fire, I will request emergency services and advise cabin crew to prepare for emergency evacuation after landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 飞机在抬前轮时左发动机起火，这种情况下我会继续起飞，到达400英尺时我会宣布紧急情况并执行发动机火警检查单。然后我会做个小起落航线并进行紧急迫降。如果无法灭火，我会请求紧急服务，并要求机组做好着陆后紧急撤离的准备。

cards.audioText: What’s the responsibility of captain and first officer when encountering an emergency?
cards.audioTextZh: 遭遇紧急情况时机长和副驾驶的职责分别是什么？
cards.referenceText: Normally the captain is responsible for controlling the aircraft, and the first officer is responsible for completing the checklist and communicating with ATC.
cards.referenceTextZh: 通常机长负责控制飞机，副驾驶执行检查并和ATC沟通。

cards.audioText: What procedure do you follow in case of emergency?
cards.audioTextZh: 紧急情况时飞行员应该执行什么程序？
cards.referenceText: We have the Quick Reference Handbook and Standard Operation Procedure on board. In case of emergency, we must strictly follow these procedures and the regulations of CAAC.
cards.referenceTextZh: 机上有快速检查单和标准操作流程。遇到紧急情况，飞行员必须严格遵从CAAC规定的流程和规定。

cards.audioText: What will you do when landing with one engine inoperative?
cards.audioTextZh: 如果着陆时有一个发动机出现故障你会怎样做？
cards.referenceText: When I encounter one engine failure, the most important thing for me to do is to control the aircraft safely. I normally use the rudder and control column to keep the aircraft stable and complete the engine-out checklist. At the same time, I will contact ATC to declare an emergency and request priority landing.
cards.referenceTextZh: 发动机出现故障时，最重要的是要安全地控制飞机。通常我会使用方向舵和操纵杆让飞机保持平衡并完成对发动机失效的检查单。同时我会联系ATC，宣布紧急情况并申请优先着陆。

cards.audioText: What should be taken into your consideration before a decision to divert?
cards.audioTextZh: 在决定改航前你会考虑哪些因素？
cards.referenceText: I will consider the fuel endurance, the weather conditions, runway length and other airport facilities in the alternative airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会考虑燃油续航能力、天气的状况、跑道长度和备降机场的其它设施。

cards.audioText: Have you reviewed emergency procedures during simulator training?
cards.audioTextZh: 你在模拟训练中练习过紧急操作程序吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, that’s the most important part of the simulator training. We practiced almost all the emergency situations in the simulator, especially some usual emergencies such as engine failure, engine fire, emergency descent, wind shear, emergency evacuation and so on.
cards.referenceTextZh: 这是模拟训练最重要的部分。在模拟训练中，我们几乎经历了所有紧急情况，尤其是常见的紧急状况，例如发动机失效、发动机起火、紧急下降、风切变和紧急疏散等。

cards.audioText: What are some of the communication requirements in your opinion during an emergency?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为紧急情况时和ATC的沟通有哪些要求？
cards.referenceText: First, I must declare emergency to ATC. In case of emergency, I should say PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN. In case of distress, I should say MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY. And all the transmission should be brief and clear.
cards.referenceTextZh: 首先，飞行员要宣布紧急情况。遇到紧急情况时，我会说PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN。遇险时我会说MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY。所有通话要简洁明确。
